final_topology.title: Government Isolated Network
final_topology.description: A network for government operations with isolated sensitive systems and secure management workstations.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network will consist of separate zones for standard and sensitive information, with dedicated management workstations and a secure internet gateway for the standard environment.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n17) that manages inventory for multiple nodes across different zones, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' node (n_new1) that is linked to the 'Asset Inventory System' (n17), indicating that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1), 'Sensitive Environment' (z2), and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2) in the 'Standard Environment' and 'Sensitive Environment', respectively, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to various nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' (n18) that manages MFA for remote devices (n21) and the 'VPN Gateway' (n22), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n19) that is linked to the 'DNS Server' (n9), indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filter' (n20) that is linked to the 'Web Proxy' (n10), indicating that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for different environments, firewalls, routers, and management workstations, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes secure management of network infrastructure through the use of version-controlled IaC, secure network protocols, and management workstations (n3, n4).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n12) that manages AAA for various nodes, indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n22) that is linked to the 'AAA Server' (n12) and remote devices (n21), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n11) that monitors traffic in the 'Standard Environment' (z1), indicating a deployed network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2) and routers (n6, n7) that perform traffic filtering between different network segments, indicating that traffic filtering is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control' node (n23) that manages access control for remote devices (n21), indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Logger' (n24) that collects traffic logs from the 'IDS/IPS' (n11) and 'SIEM' (n13), indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1) and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Workstation' (n16) and a 'Pen Test Process' (n25) that are linked to the 'Standard Environment' (z1), indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z4 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, it includes various nodes and zones that could be part of an inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.evidence: The topology includes several data flow links (e.g., nl5, nl6, nl7, etc.), but there is no explicit documentation of these data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: Explicit documentation of data flows is not present in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link that explicitly represents data flow documentation.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Workstation' (n16) and a 'Pen Test Process' (n25) with a data flow link (nl40), but there is no explicit indication of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: Explicit documentation or scheduling of periodic external penetration tests is not present in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link that explicitly represents the scheduling and documentation of periodic external penetration tests.
